title_original: Bella Glanville Signs With Established Artists

blocks.text: EXCLUSIVE: Bella Glanville has signed with Established Artists .
The British model and Geek Girl actress joins the roster of international talents on the books at Established, and will be represented by Tonja René.

Glanville, who is based in L.A., was most recently in Chad Ferrin’s Sunset Strip Killers , playing one of the victims of real-life serial killers Doug Clark and Carol Bundy. She was also shortlisted at the BAFTA Film Awards for Best Short Film for her short Imperfect Cadence and had a recurring role in Seasons 1 and 2 of Netflix’s Geek Girl .
Away from the screen, she is an international model and has fronted campaigns for the likes of Coca-Cola, Stella Mccartney, Valentino and Adidas and appeared on the covers of magazines such as Vogue.

For Established Artists, the signing is a third this month. It added actress, writer, director and producer Natasha Ofili, who acted in Creed III and The Politician , to its ranks for representation soon after it signed Anne-Marie MacKay, veteran writer-producer and co-founder of Propaganda Films, for management.
Patrick Havern launched Established Artists in 2021 as a full service talent management company.
